# Linux for my Mac

Target: MacBook Air M1, 2020 (`MacBookAir10,1`). Base: Fedora Asahi Remix with KDE Plasma. This is an installation/boot setup project, not a newly authored Linux kernel or a completed native installation.

Open the project in Dock for the preparation checklist and installer launcher download. Run the downloaded launcher in macOS with `bash "$HOME/Downloads/install-linux.command"`. It checks the model, requires explicit installation confirmation and source review, and starts the official interactive installer from https://alx.sh. Do not run it on the cloud development machine.

Back up important data before installation. Follow https://asahilinux.org/fedora/ for current support, prerequisites and installer guidance. Keep macOS and recovery; do not erase the drive. No generic PC/Intel ISO or USB installer is supplied for this Apple Silicon machine.

After completing installation, shut down, hold the power button to open startup options, and select Linux. A website cannot switch a physical Mac into another OS. Subsequent customization can be developed here after Linux is installed and tested on the hardware.
